answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in zenith, verified in jade, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mesa check. A farm of 753 identities would post 2268 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
